name: Clockwork Grove
subtitle: Idle Lumber Tycoon
tagline: Chop wind-up trees, build a crew of clockwork choppers and rewind the Great Clock.
short: An idle lumber tycoon set in a forest of brass and gears.
metaDescription: Play Clockwork Grove, a free idle lumber tycoon in your browser. Chop clockwork trees, hire choppers, unlock six districts and rewind for bonuses.
intro: Clockwork Grove is an idle lumber tycoon set in an overgrown forest of brass and copper trees, wound by gears nobody remembers installing. You arrive with a hand axe. You leave with a crew of clockwork choppers and a Great Clock wound back in your favour.

Swing at the tree in front of you to earn Sparkwood. Spend it on a sharper axe and on wind-up choppers who keep swinging while you do something else. Unlock six districts, each with tougher trees that pay far more, then rewind the Great Clock to start over with a permanent bonus.

howto.title: How to play
steps: Chop. Click or tap the tree, or press Space or Enter. You earn Sparkwood for every point of damage.
Keep a combo. Every swing within {{comboWindow}} seconds of the last one builds a combo. Each {{comboStep}} swings raises your damage by {{comboBonus}}, up to {{comboMax}}.
Buy upgrades. Open the Upgrades panel. Sharper axes raise the damage of every swing, yours and your choppers'.
Hire choppers. Clockwork choppers swing on their own, even while you are away.
Unlock districts. Each one has rarer trees. Uncommon trees and above drop gears, which buy the powerful upgrades at the bottom of the list.

Rewind. Once you reach the Heart of the Grove, rewind the Great Clock. You lose your Sparkwood, upgrades and districts and keep the mainsprings you earned. Each mainspring gives +{{prestigeBonus}} Sparkwood forever.

tips: Overkill counts. A swing that deals 40 damage to a 10-health tree is paid for all 40, so axe upgrades never stop being worth it.
The first chopper costs very little and starts earning on its own. Buy one early even if you are still clicking.
Choppers keep working while the tab is closed, at {{offlineEff}} efficiency for up to {{offlineCapHours}} hours. The Wind-up Reserve and Long Spring upgrades raise both limits.
Your progress is saved in this browser. Open Settings to export a save code before clearing site data or switching devices.

faq.a: Yes. It runs in your browser with no download, no account and no purchase. There is nothing to buy.

faq.q: Does the game keep running when I close the tab?
faq.a: Your clockwork choppers keep earning while you are away, at a reduced rate and for a limited time. You collect the result when you come back.
In your browser's local storage on this device. Nothing is sent to a server. Use Settings, then Export save code, to move a save somewhere else.
It restarts the run in exchange for mainsprings, a permanent currency. Each one adds {{prestigeBonus}} to all Sparkwood you earn, so every run is faster than the last.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. The game is built for touch as well as mouse and keyboard, in portrait or landscape.

zh.name: 发条森林
zh.subtitle: 放置伐木大亨
zh.metaTitle: 发条森林：放置伐木大亨
zh.tagline: 砍下发条树，组建机械砍伐队，让大钟倒转。
zh.short: 在一片黄铜与齿轮的森林里做的放置伐木游戏。
zh.metaDescription: 在浏览器里免费玩《发条森林》：砍发条树、雇砍伐机、解锁六个区域，再让大钟倒转换取永久加成。不用下载，不用注册。
intro: 《发条森林》是一款放置伐木游戏，舞台是一片被黄铜与铜树占满的林子，给树上的发条是谁装的，已经没人记得。你来的时候只有一把手斧；走的时候，身后是一队发条砍伐机，和一口被你倒转过的大钟。
对着眼前的树挥砍就能得到星火木。拿它换更锋利的斧头，再雇几台会自己挥砍的发条砍伐机。解锁六个区域，每个区域的树更硬，给得也更多；最后让大钟倒转，带着一份永久加成从头再来。

howto.title: 怎么玩
steps: 砍树。点击或轻触树，也可以按 空格 或 回车。每造成一点伤害都有星火木。
保持连击。两次挥砍间隔不超过 {{comboWindow}} 秒就能攒连击。每 {{comboStep}} 次提升 {{comboBonus}} 伤害，最高到 {{comboMax}}。
买升级。打开升级面板。斧头越锋利，你的每一击和砍伐机的每一击都更重。
雇砍伐机。发条砍伐机自己会挥砍，你不在的时候也在干活。
解锁区域。越往后树越稀有。罕见及以上的树会掉齿轮，用来买列表末尾那几项强力升级。
传承。到达林之心之后，可以让大钟倒转。星火木、升级和区域清空，但到手的主发条会留下，每枚永久提高 +{{prestigeBonus}} 星火木。

tips: 溢出伤害照样算钱。一斧 40 伤害砸在只剩 10 点耐久的树上，40 全给。所以斧头升级永远不亏。
第一台砍伐机很便宜，而且会自己开始赚钱。哪怕你还在手动点，也尽早买一台。
关掉标签页后砍伐机还在工作，效率 {{offlineEff}}，最多 {{offlineCapHours}} 小时。「发条储备」和「长发条」能提高这两个上限。
进度存在这个浏览器里。清除站点数据或换设备之前，先打开设置导出一份存档码。

faq.a: 不收费。它在浏览器里直接运行，不用下载、不用账号，也没有任何内购。

faq.q: 关掉标签页之后游戏还在跑吗？
faq.a: 砍伐机会继续替你赚钱，但效率下降、时长有限。回来时收一下即可。
存在这台设备的浏览器本地存储里，不会上传到服务器。想把存档搬到别处，用设置里的「导出存档码」。
传承会重开一局，换来主发条这种永久货币。每枚提高 {{prestigeBonus}} 的星火木产出，所以每一局都比上一局快。
能。触屏、鼠标键盘都支持，横屏竖屏都行。
